The '''Diophos Spur''' was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that included the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Arbooine/Legends|Arbooine]],<ref name="CharEnc" /> which it connected to the more widely-known [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]]. The route was little-used, though came to the attention of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. By this period, the route led into [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] space, and the Republic intended on utilizing Arbooine as a staging point into Separatist territory until battle lines shifted.<ref name="COTG" />
